title: SafeChat: Message Moderation
context: Group-chat apps filter abusive phrases, throttle spammers and catch disguised words without slowing delivery.
input: Messages (user, time, text); banned phrases; flag lists.

milestones.title: Repeated messages
milestones.requirement: Identical message hashes repeated by a user.

milestones.title: Disguised words
milestones.requirement: Edit distance between a message word and a banned word (memo table).

milestones.title: Merge moderator flags
milestones.requirement: Merge two moderators’ time-sorted flag lists.

milestones.title: Phrase filter
milestones.requirement: Count banned phrase occurrences in a message (KMP).

milestones.title: Messages in a window
milestones.requirement: Sorted timestamps: count messages in [t1, t2).

milestones.title: Markup validation
milestones.requirement: Validate nested formatting markers with a stack.
